evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and directly modifies Guix build recipes, glibc patches, and ELF validation scripts in contrib/guix/.
rationale: Producing static-pie release binaries resolves significant portability barriers across Linux distributions. According to the release notes and testing feedback, release binaries can now run on non-glibc systems like Alpine, NixOS without loaders, and older distributions with unsupported host glibc versions.
